observations.seen: Animated hand and tap rings demonstrate double taps; swipe hand demonstrates exclusion. Unrelated cells are darkened while the relevant row/column/region remains visible.
observations.scope: Observed instructional screens, not all accessibility/gesture edge cases.

observations.seen: Cats blink/look sideways when idle; correct placement uses closed-eye smile and small heart; visible conflict changes both proposed and existing cats to startled/distressed expressions.
observations.scope: Facial changes observed in live screenshots; implementation technology and frame count unknown.

observations.seen: Floating positive score appears at the actual cell, with multicolor sparkles and region-colored fragments; top found silhouettes turn into cat heads and top score subsequently shows the accumulated amount.
observations.scope: Sampled visible score increments were 576,672,768,864 across a four-find sequence; not a frozen scoring formula or duration model.

observations.seen: Wrong R1C1 highlights the pink region, connects wrong and given cats and flashes the region rule card. Wrong R1C5 highlights the row segment/connection and row-column rule card. Wrong R2C4 highlights neighboring cells/diagonal connection and adjacency rule card.
observations.scope: Same-region example also shares row; three samples do not prove the complete multiple-conflict priority. L1 wrong R1C1 had no visible conflict with its distant given cat and showed generic error instead.

observations.seen: A consumed fish life visibly fragments before becoming a pale silhouette. At one life, board darkens and a short message focuses attention on life HUD; tapping message dismisses it.

Nice and Great labels differ in color/visual treatment. Last find causes all board cats to smile. Result shows a large posed/animated full-body cat, radial light and confetti; the two sampled wins use different celebration outfits/props and praise copy.
observations.scope: Excellent not observed. Exact random selection and input-ready timings not measured; preserve original Capydoku no-extra-input-delay requirement.

observations.seen: Board tiles appear in staggered small-to-full scale states. L3 restart retained observed layout/given position and refilled lives.
observations.scope: Only one restart sample; no change to Capydoku formal restart policy inferred.

observations.where: L2 hint and L3 direct answer
observations.seen: Hint uses dimming plus hollow X previews that become solid on Apply; inventory changed 5 to 4. Direct answer added a cat with local score and Clear label, inventory changed 5 to 4.
observations.scope: No real rewarded ad used. Preview close behavior was not tested.

recommendedWork.title: 可见错误原因解释
recommendedWork.current: Only generic per-cell mistake sequence; RuleStrip is static.
recommendedWork.add: Visible-conflict query, region/row/column/adjacency highlight, short line to conflicting found character, corresponding rule-card acknowledgement.
acceptance: Explain only conflicts with currently found/given characters; no fabricated reason from hidden solution.
One accepted mistake still deducts life once; effect does not mutate board, block further input or survive session replacement.
Test region, row, column, adjacency, multiple conflicts and wrong-with-no-visible-conflict.
recommendedWork.scope: New explanatory feedback, no change to correctness rules.

recommendedWork.add: Consistent original capy idle/blink, happy, startled/wrong and sad states; whole-body win/loss motion resources.
acceptance: Fixed art size/anchor and consistent design across frames or layers.
Expression events follow accepted model events; background/exit/reduced motion handled.
recommendedWork.scope: Use original Capydoku assets; reference appearance is not an asset package.

acceptance: Derive demonstration positions from current tutorial targets, never hard-code one board.
Retain undo, both swipe axes and all four rules; demonstration never performs player moves.
Re-entry, restoration and reduced-motion states remain understandable.

recommendedWork.title: 格子到顶部的奖励与扣命联动

Local score must fit edge cells, 10x10 boards and dynamic text.
Use original heart/life presentation contract, not wholesale fish icon substitution.

implementationStatus: Recommendations only in this follow-up; production build remains 0.2.23 (26).

mapping.implementation: Three original transparent strips, three genuinely different key poses each: joyful arm raise, star hug/presentation, and disappointed sigh/recovery. Existing Capydoku identity is the visual source; no Meowdoku artwork copied. Finite animation retains an expressive static final pose on restore, reduced motion or cancellation.

Last-board feedback leads into character, then title and explanation, with finite radial light and confetti. Next/revive/restart remain immediately available. Root focus avoids hidden headings and must not steal focus from a player who already moved to an action.

Dims board and focuses the measured life HUD. An explicit tap dismisses the reminder, without spending life or marking the underlying cell. Board gestures and underlying accessibility are locked while shown; restored/background/covered changes do not replay it.

A muted reward plaque lights only after a saved claim. Streak and current-day circle are emphasized, followed by actual committed hint/direct inventory deltas. Calendar stays visible and actions never wait. A failed write cannot celebrate; duplicate claims, reentry, cancellation and restored state cannot replay.

User explicitly authorized attempting original Meowdoku audio for testing. Nine decoded local source files cover ten existing event mappings in Debug internal_demo only; settings clearly labels reference audio as internal testing. Formal audio manifest remains empty and unverified; Git ignores source clips and distribution/archive builds remove them.
